findings.finding: The wheel and sdist omit an eagerly imported training sampler module.
findings.resolution: Explicitly load unchanged NPE core through a namespace; preserve all six upstream source bytes.

findings.finding: Upstream finite rejection timeout can append unchecked candidates.
findings.resolution: Mandatory max_iter_rejection=None; external Slurm timeout fails an incomplete run. No clipping or filler samples.
findings.evidence: inference wrapper, frozen manifest contract and support integrity checks

findings.finding: Seed/case names alone cannot authenticate a workload.
findings.resolution: Bind bank/query array descriptors, scientific fingerprint/order, source hashes, checkpoint, frozen settings and derived RNG stream.

findings.finding: CDF precision alone does not qualify mean and SD decisions.
findings.resolution: Retain all-coordinate scramble/refinement moment convergence and propagate numerical intervals into bias/SD gates.

findings.finding: The original 513 queries have marginal steps up to 0.159, too coarse for reliable conservative pass certification.
findings.resolution: Refine only fixed-reference query intervals, retaining original CDFs and moments; require step and numerical precision at most 0.005.
findings.evidence: all eight refined reference manifests and deterministic history replay

findings.finding: Automatic restart could outlive one cost reservation.
findings.resolution: Disable requeue on all subsequent submissions; first three completed jobs independently show Restarts=0.

findings.finding: Requested ranks/model-visible devices do not establish allocated cost.
findings.resolution: Reconcile actual AllocTRES GPU count times ElapsedRaw; handle generic and typed entries without double-counting; export both requested and actual resources.

findings.finding: The initial live aggregator labeled unfinished runs as execution failures.
findings.resolution: Running/pending/missing evidence yields incomplete, never a terminal failure or pass. Historical stage snapshots are superseded by the refined-reference and final scientific reports.

findings.finding: Constructor duration excludes model loading in first fit.
findings.resolution: Name constructor/import duration explicitly and flag cold checkpoint load inside request latency; no warm-latency claim.
findings.evidence: inference manifest timing fields and report CSV

findings.finding: Private source or model downloads must not be required for CPU CI/base installation.
findings.resolution: Fresh public clone, wheel/sdist build, outside-checkout tests and CLI checks; separate pinned model preparation and notices.
